topic:student-visa:work_term_time:2026.quote: If your Student sponsor has a track record of compliance and your course is full-time, your hours of work are: ⏎ Up to 20 hours a week in term time if you are studying for a qualification at degree level or above. ... Full time outside term time (for study at all levels), which includes in vacations ... Always check any limits on work that your university, college or school imposes or recommends. ... You may be able to work - how much depends on what you’re studying and whether you’re working in or out of term-time. ⏎ You cannot: ... be self-employed
